verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਸਤ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jat sat si(n)ghaasan sahaj sa(n)tokh ma(n)tree dharam dheeraj dhujaa abichal raaj hai ||

en.bdb: The obedient Gursikh of the True Guru has truth and true morals as his throne while patience and contentment are his ministers. His flag is the eternal persevering righteousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਇਆ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਭਾਗ ਤਉ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: siv nagaree nivaas dhiaa dhulahanee milee bhaag tau bha(n)ddaaree bhaau bhojan sakaaj hai ||

en.bdb: That Sikh of the Guru resides in the tenth opening like capital of his body. Kindness is his prime queen. His past deeds and fortune is his treasurer while love is his royal feast and food. He is not a slave of worldly delicacies,

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਕੈ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਛਿਮਾ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: arath beechaar paramaarath kai raajaneet chhatrapat chhimaa chhatr chhaiaa chhab chhaaj hai ||

en.bdb: His policy of reigning is to establish a kingdom of humility and righteousness. Forgiveness is his canopy under which he sits. The comforting and peace giving shade of his canopy is known all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਨਦ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੬॥
verses.translit_en: aanadh samooh sukh saa(n)t parajaa prasa(n)n jagamag jot anahadh dhun baaj hai ||246||

en.bdb: Peace and comfort to all are his happy subjects. By the practice of Naam Simran and his capital being in the tenth door where the divine radiance is ever effulgent, the unstruck melody is constantly playing in his capital. (246)
